signatures.description: Model the Linux io_uring completion engine from a trace of SQEs and emit the exact CQE stream, honoring IOSQE_IO_LINK chains broken with -ECANCELED, IOSQE_IO_DRAIN barriers, IORING_OP_LINK_TIMEOUT versus IORING_OP_TIMEOUT expiry, IOSQE_ASYNC, and IOSQE_CQE_SKIP_SUCCESS. Issue order comes from the SQ array while completions may arrive out of order, so each op must settle into exactly one terminal result (res value or negative errno), and traces that reference unissued op ids or reuse a user_data field must be rejected by reporting the first protocol violation in kernel order.
